blocks.text: A pick and roll is an action where a teammate screens the ball handler’s defender, then moves toward the basket. The ball handler can drive, pass to the rolling teammate or find another open player. Defensive responses include switching, dropping and showing help; the best choice depends on personnel and spacing.

blocks.text: PPG and APG are points and assists per valid appearance. Shooting percentages use summed makes and attempts, rather than averaging game percentages. Effective field-goal percentage accounts for the extra value of made three-pointers. True shooting uses points relative to shooting opportunities with the declared free-throw approximation. A research sample filter is separate from NBA leader qualification.
